acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The gel pieces were destained in 60% methanol, 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (ABC). Solutions were removed by centrifugation for 2 minutes at 600×g. Proteins were reduced in 10 mM DTT, 50 mM ABC for one hour at 56 °C, and alkylated for 45 minutes in 30 mM iodoacetamide, 50 mM ABC at room temperature.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were then digested for 16 hours with 5 ng/µl trypsin (sequencing grade, Promega) in 50 mM ABC, 0.01% Protease Max (Promega), and 1 mM CaCl₂ at 37°C.
